comments.author: Peter Kiemann
comments.text:
BINDING-INTROSPECTION PROOF DESIGN (lead, 2026-09-09, for the cluster-4 prerequisite) Shape: one CPU contract test (lives beside dispatch_contract_tests.rs) that loops every primitive on the standalone codegen path (inventory-driven, same enumeration the codemod will rewrite) and: 1. generates the kernel via codegen::standalone_for_spec::

(), 2. naga-reflects the module's (group, binding) -> resource-kind/name list, 3. compares it against the call-site binding order. To make (3) CPU-testable, the dispatch-tail codemod must FIRST factor binding-list construction into a pure function (e.g. standalone_bindings(inputs, uniforms, out) -> Vec) separate from the encoder call. The test then asserts the helper's emitted order == the kernel's reflected order for every atom. That is the independent oracle: kernel WGSL (generated, reflected) vs Rust binding list (helper), no GPU needed. Sequencing consequence: the proof and the helper land TOGETHER — the proof is written against the pre-codemod sites by deriving the expected order from each atom's current dispatch tail (survey), then the codemod is constrained to atoms the proof classifies as uniform+1-texture-out, and the proof flips to asserting the helper. Qualifying-set definition (the classification the codemod consumes): generated kernel has exactly binding(0) var Params + binding(N) one storage write texture + zero or more read texture/sampler bindings in the codegen's standard order, and the run() tail is a single dispatch_compute with bindings built inline. Non-qualifying shapes stay hand-written and get listed in the landing report (multi-output, buffer-array atoms, conditional binds, per-draw binding loops).

comments.author: Peter Kiemann
comments.text: Cluster-4 prerequisite LANDED 2026-09-10 (b10b9e25d): binding_contract_tests naga-reflects all 161 standalone kernels (contiguity + census ratchet), pins the canonical texture-path set at 89 atoms; dispatch_standalone_2d + standalone_2d_slots in standalone_pipeline.rs proven equal to every canonical kernel's reflected order (canonical_kernels_match_dispatch_helper_slot_order). invert + gain converted as runtime pilot — gpu-proofs green. Codemod constraints: rewrite only sites whose inline tail is the exact stereotype (Bytes(0) + Texture in port order + Sampler + out Texture, div_ceil(16) grid); per-site verify texture order == port order; leave non-stereotyped tails and report them. description: crates/manifold-app/src/midi_import.rs:67-68: LED lanes fall into the video-lane arm, so imported clips get the BasicShapes generator fallback instead of staying LED-appropriate. Fix intent with Peter during DMX campaign (BUG-ng6a): decide what MIDI import should mean on a DMX lane (probably skip or treat as generator-like).

title: BUG: Timeline::add_layer LED path seeds no gen_params
description: crates/manifold-core/src/timeline.rs:352 (verify at fix): the LED branch of add_layer does not seed gen_params, unlike the AddLayerCommand path which does (crates/manifold-editing/src/commands/layer.rs:46-57). Latent — only reachable if something calls Timeline::add_layer directly instead of the command. Fix: seed the same default (LED Fill) or assert the path is dead and delete it.
notes: Adversarial review 2026-09-04: no production change in timeline.rs needed — its LED arm calls change_generator_type, which the BUG-ng6a P3a guard widening fixes automatically. Resolution = P3a regression test (add_layer with Led + LED Fill → gen_params seeded).

title: warped-clip-in-point-advance-uses-project-spb
description: The in_point advance in split_clip_at_beat, trim paths, and trim_clip_to_region uses project spb (beats x 60/project_bpm), but playback for clips with recorded_bpm>0 advances source time at 60/recorded_bpm (PlaybackEngine::get_clip_source_elapsed_seconds, engine.rs:2134). Warped clips that are split or left-trimmed get a warp-ratio offset in their in_point — the audio starts slightly early/late relative to where playback computes it. Sites: service.rs split_clip_at_beat + trim_clip_to_region, interaction_overlay.rs trim-left (~line 2115). Fix shape: advance by 60/recorded_bpm (or resolved recorded spb) when recorded_bpm>0, project spb otherwise; needs the recorded spb at all call sites.
notes: Opus audit 2026-09-29, class is wider than audio: (1) warped VIDEO too: engine get_clip_source_elapsed_seconds uses try_get_clip_recorded_spb for any clip, and resolve_clip_recorded_bpm falls back to project.recording_provenance.recorded_project_bpm, so every video clip in a recorded project is warped; all editing in_point math uses flat settings.bpm. (2) Missed site: service.rs:332 (enforce_non_overlap case 2, placing over a clip start). (3) Unwarped clips in a project with a tempo map: engine uses tempo-map seconds, editing uses one flat settings.bpm (content_commands.rs:1781/1792, input_host.rs, editing_host.rs, ui_bridge/editing.rs). (4) editing_host get_max_duration_beats video branch uses project spb, so the trim-right limit for warped video is wrong. (5) Two rules for recorded tempo: core TimelineClip::recorded_bpm_resolved ignores the provenance fallback, engine resolve_clip_recorded_bpm uses it. Fix shape: one core helper, clip + project + beat span -> source seconds (recorded tempo with provenance, else tempo map), used by engine, service, UI trim and max-duration. BUG-b2vm is a subset.
close_reason: fixed: core SourceClock is the one beat-span to media-seconds conversion for every left-edge edit (UI trim, split, region copy/cut, overlap trim, interior split, trim-right limit); flat spb parameter removed from EditingService/AddClipCommand/Layer::add_clip; recorded-tempo rule shared with the engine. Tests: tempo::tests::source_clock_*, service splitting_warped_audio_starts_the_tail_at_the_recorded_tempo k3 (lead)

title: scene-loop remove leaves legacy fog nodes
description: SCENE_LOOP P4 leftover: RemoveSceneLoopCommand on a pre-P4 project (P1-P3 fog era) strips the Scene Loop exposure rows but leaves the old loop_fog/fog_driver nodes in the graph — they are not in the new plan's three-node set, so the inverse-of-plan removal never targets them. Cosmetic (pre-release state, not in Peter's acceptance path: Remove + re-apply upgrades the graph), but the graph keeps dead fog nodes + a phantom atmosphere wire. Fix shape: extend RemoveSceneLoopCommand's loop-node match to also drop nodes with stable node_ids loop_fog/fog_driver when present, or document the re-apply upgrade path in the design doc's P4 marker.

title: VD: scene-loop copies gate — pixel-level proof on a real lit import (structural gate + probe landed instead)
description: SCENE_LOOP P2 landed with: structural e2e gate on the real apricot import (builder+command+wiring) + pixel copies proof via hand-built probe graph (scene_loop_probe.rs). Gap: apricot renders near-black through the headless render_viewport_frame runtime (raw import equally black — no lighting/env in the throwaway runtime), so pixel-level copies assertion on a REAL import was waived. Fix: a headless fixture path with lighting (or a lit corridor GLB fixture), then upgrade scene_loop_e2e_import.rs to pixel assertions.
close_reason: Full corridor P1-P3 and root-level shared control/temporal fixes landed and pushed on 2026-09-06. Native Stone Effects acceptance 7/7 passes, ordinary tests 4320 pass, and final landing gate has six passes and zero failures. GPU proofs explicitly deferred with Peter approval under pre-existing BUG-cam, which remains open. Native GPU resource contracts and LED upload fixture corrected. Far-edge fallback superseded; real-import pixel acceptance folded into P3. Oversized preview video history repaired with approval; files preserved locally.

title: scene-loop: real-import renders are device-seed nondeterministic (AO/cinematic path) — INV-3 cannot gate on real fixtures
description: flash-scene-loop-p2 finding: same-input renders of an apricot import differ ~80 pixels per GpuDevice — AO/cinematic path is device-seed nondeterministic. INV-3 wrap parity stays gated on the minimal deterministic graph (tests/scene_loop_wrap_parity.rs). To gate pixel parity on REAL imports later: seed control in the AO/cinematic path (same family as scripts/rt_noise_gate.py ceilings).

title: Archive history pruning + single-read save
description: Manual snapshots never prune (audioTesting2.manifold: 59MB file = 2.6MB project + 572 gzipped snapshots) and every save copies all history blobs plus reads the archive 4x (is_v2_archive/read_manifest/read_entry_bytes/copy_history_entries each do a full fs::read). Fix: cap or time-decay manual snapshots, or move history out of the archive; read file bytes once per save.

title: Runtime AddSceneFog density slider ignores scene scale
description: Fog density slider on the runtime AddSceneFog gesture (AddSceneFogCommand, manifold-editing) uses the generic primitive 0..1 range with no scene scale — per-world-unit density, so the same drag is invisible on a small scene and a white wall on a big one (feeds BUG-118 fog wash-out). Fix shape: plumb the scene PresetMetadata.scene_bounds (already read at runtime by scene_vm.rs:512) into the fog-add command so the stamped density range/default derive from scene radius (e.g. 0..2/radius). Deliberately NOT done at import: the atmosphere node was dropped from imports 2026-07-15 (commit 6ebffd932) — fog is runtime-only. Found during the BUG-upfq scene-scale wave (P4 descoped).
close_reason: Fixed on main (merge 86eb81cee): AddSceneFogCommand overrides the stamped fog_density band to 0..2/radius from PresetMetadata.scene_bounds; procedural scenes keep the generic 0..1

title: DoF auto-focus: focus camera on a point on the model
description: Peter (2026-08-29): tuning focus_distance by hand is hard in scenes with camera distances 0-1. Feature: auto-focus — drive focus_distance from the scene depth at a chosen target (tap-to-focus style: a normalized screen point or a tracked anchor on the model; read the depth texture at that point, smooth/follow per frame). Lives in the camera lens chain (node.camera_lens writes focus_distance); needs a design pass on target selection + smoothing so it is performable, not jittery. Depends on the DoF strength tuning bead landing first so focus behavior is calibrated.
close_reason: Duplicate of BUG-b727 (DoF auto-focus) — identical body, same-day double-create

description: Peter (2026-08-29): tuning focus_distance by hand is hard in scenes with camera distances 0-1. title: project_tool set-rt-quality: export.spatial_denoise does not persist
description: Reported by capture lane 2026-08-28: project_tool settings set-rt-quality <file> export spatial_denoise off prints success but the value is unchanged after save; the realtime column persists correctly. Suspect the export-column write path in settings_set_rt_quality (project_tool.rs) drops the field through the archive writer. Repro: set export spatial_denoise off on any project, project_tool json shows previous value. Fix shape: trace the export-column arm of settings_set_rt_quality and the raw-JSON write it emits.
notes: 2026-08-28 widened: same non-persistence hits effect set-genparam on clip genParams — set 8_rt_enabled=0 --layer 0 on a DamagedHelmet clip prints "saved", file is rewritten (key order changed), but value stays 1.0. Reconcile warnings point at BUG-079 (project-local preset not registered after registration pass) restoring values. Likely one root cause for both arms: the surgical raw-JSON write targets a path the loader/reconcile then overrides, or the write lands on the wrong JSON node. title: Retune export RT settings once a denoiser lands
description: Exports at 4K max RT take hours; trace time dominates. After the spatial denoiser (or legacy MetalFX bench) lands, retune export ray-res/spp for equal perceived quality at a fraction of trace time. Blocked on the stage-3 work.

title: Benchmark legacy-path MetalFX denoised scaler at real render res
description: Crimson Desert ships the legacy-path denoiser in production. "Really really slow" is an unmeasured memory. Wrapper already has the classic fallback wired (denoiser.rs). Measure cost at export render res before building the in-house a-trous pass — if acceptable, it is the cheapest stage 3 available. Reported heavy in games (M5 Max needed sub-1080p for 30fps), but export budgets differ.

title: Standalone repro for MTL4Compiler + MTLFXTemporalDenoisedScaler SIGABRT
description: Zero-MANIFOLD ~30-line repro of the creation-time MPSGraph abort (metalfx_m4.rs:35-60, bisected 2026-08-11 on 26.6.1). Settles Apple-bug-vs-ours definitively and doubles as the Feedback Assistant attachment. Crimson Desert ships MetalFX denoising (likely legacy creation path), so Apple-vs-us is genuinely open. Related: BUG-woji (availability probe checks protocol name as class).

title: Pipeline archive save fails every launch — compute-only pipeline 283 breaks machO pack
description: Every launch logs: Failed to save pipeline archive — cannot pack ... missing vertex stage in pipeline no. 283 (manifold_gpu::metal::archive). A compute-only pipeline in the archive makes Metals machO pack fail, so the binary archive never persists. MSL source cache absorbs the cost today (271/271 hits observed), but if it ever misses, cold-launch shader compiles return with no archive fallback. Fix shape: exclude compute-only pipelines from the binary archive (or drop the archive in favor of the MSL cache if it buys nothing). Identify pipeline 283 first — the index may be deterministic since the failure is stable across runs.

title: Dead LensRowVm duplicates lens slider ranges
description: Dead LensRowVm duplicates lens slider ranges (inspector.rs:681-705 hardcodes focus 0-1000, f_stop 0.5-1000; scene_setup_panel.rs:466-496,3150 fixture). Never rendered — build_camera_section renders stamped specs via build_filtered_properties — but it is a stale second source of truth that misdirected the 2026-08-27 range-bug investigation. Fix shape: delete LensRowVm, its construction in inspector.rs lens_row closure, and the panel struct fields + test fixture.

title: Scene-param ergonomics: scene-scale normalization + spring-return push sliders for XYZ transforms
description: Peter 2026-08-26, verbatim threads: (1) "normalise the scene params in some way based on the import or scene setup" — derive param ranges/defaults from the imported scene scale (bbox), so a 555-unit scene and a 7-unit scene both get sensible sliders. Foothold exists: gltf_import already computes the bbox framing distance to seed focus_distance; this generalizes it (focus/f-stop ranges, transform slider ranges, light ranges). (2) "a special type of slider or control for the XYZ transform controls that are absolute at the moment — a push slider that returns to middle that lets you move the objects with sensible and easy movement... would also need to still work with our drivers, LFOs, modulation" — a spring-return jog control writing deltas onto the base value. The open design question (his words: "not sure exactly how this would work and needs a future design discussion"): how the jog interleaves with the modulation stack — who owns the base value while a driver/LFO rides the same param (candidate shapes: jog writes an offset that composes like mapping affine, or jog edits base while drivers read base+mod — the BUG-260 write/read asymmetry class is the trap).
notes: 2026-09-02: load-repair follow-up on main (merge eed5a67e4) — scene bands now derive from one shared table (manifold_core::scene_exposure::scene_scaled_range); pass 4 no longer reverts them on load. Existing projects self-repair on next load via stored scene_bounds.

title: VD: section export UI — L2 reached / L3 target (ui-flow for Cmd+M + Split Sections checkbox)
description: Landing 8c735a34f reached L2 (journey-proof real export, ffprobe-verified). No scripts/ui-flows flow drives Cmd+M or the checkbox yet. Write one per DESIGN_DOC_STANDARD section 10.

description: Optional always-face-camera mode for the layer plane (BUG-4gba). Camera-plane flattening already exists for particles (flatten_to_camera_plane); a billboard param is a small follow-up once the plane ships.

First cut was sign-flipped vs euler_xyz_columns; landed tests drive the real model_matrix. k3 (lead)

title: Missing-layer chip covers layer planes
description: Extend the D8 missing-layer chip (currently Skin row only) to layer planes from BUG-4gba so a deleted source layer is loud on the panel, not just silent black in the render.
close_reason: Landed with lane/layer-plane-ui: scene_vm test proves a base_color_map layer_source with a missing layer id yields SkinVm source_missing=true target BaseColor — the D8 chip covers planes, no new UI needed. k3 (lead)

close_reason: Landed: + Plane button dispatches AddSceneLayerPlaneCommand (width from output-resolution aspect); dead compact Import button replaced (verified overwritten id). k3 (lead)

title: Emissive strength param on the Skin row
description: Expose emissive strength on the scene panel Skin row (or object card) so skin glow is ridable without digging into raw emission_r/g/b material params. Must follow WIDGET_TREE_DESIGN section 5b param_surface — no bespoke sliders.
close_reason: Landed: emission_strength (0..10, default 1.0) on node.scene_object, rides the reserved emission.w uniform slot, scales raster resolve_emissive (both branches) and RT GiMaterial emission consistently. Slider defers onto the Skin row via param_surface/build_param_row — modulation arms work. Old projects byte-identical at default. k3 (lead)

title: Skin feeds RT GI and light shafts
description:
RT emissive light table is built from d.uniforms.emission (static factor) at accel-build time — never the map. Work: texture-aware table weights + mean power. Lead-seat design.

DESIGN 2026-09-01 (k3 lead): the per-frame live-texture half this bead was written for already landed via BUG-1gqt. RtObjectGeometry is rebuilt EVERY FRAME from opaque_draws (render_scene.rs:5462, `emissive_texture: d.emissive_map`); ensure_normal_sources (raytrace.rs:4462) rebuilds the material-texture indirection per frame; the GI kernel samples the live map with UV transform at the gather point (raytrace.rs:1980-1996), mirroring resolve_emissive. Textured emissive GI is proven by the rt_p3_emissive_texture fixture. So a video/generator skin already lights the scene through RT GI today — correctness needs no per-frame table rebuild.

What is genuinely static (texture-blind), all in build_emissive_table (raytrace.rs): (1) table membership gates on luma(GiMaterial.emissive factor) > 0 and alias weights are area x factor luma — skinned objects enter because skin.rs apply_emissive_binding whites the factor to 1.0, but a mostly-dark texture still gets uniform-area sampling: variance, not correctness; (2) emissive_table_mean_power feeds the RS8 firefly cap and the probe floor (render_scene.rs:310) from the factor alone.

Remaining work (one budgeted piece): per-emissive-object GPU mean reduction of the live emissive texture (mip chain, 1-frame-lagged readback), scaling that object table weight and the shared mean_power; alias-table rebuild hysteresis-gated on material mean change. Budget call against RT quality settings — Peter decides whether the noise win justifies the reduction pass. Full per-triangle textured-power rebuild per frame: rejected (weights shift variance, not correctness; RIS + firefly clamp already hold).

title: Audit sRGB vs linear on skinned map ports
description: Baked glTF emissive/base maps are sRGB byte textures; layer skins are linear Rgba16Float. Verify the sample view formats make both land linear in render_scene.wgsl on the same port; fix any response inconsistency. Suspect: texture view format at bind time in render_scene.rs.
close_reason: Audit verdict: consistent, no bug. gltf_texture_source uploads sRGB color maps as Rgba8UnormSrgb (color_space param, gltf_texture_source.rs:247), Metal auto-decodes on sample during the stretch-blit into the chain-allocated linear float out slot; layer_source writes linear values into the same chain-slot format. Both producers land linear float on the map port, so render_scene samples one consistent color space. k3 (lead) 2026-08-26.

title: Compositor harness: A-over-B regardless of clip order (unexplained)
description: P4a finisher observed: in its two-layer test harness the composite shows layer A over B regardless of clip sort order; per-layer textures and registry provably correct. Non-blocking, mechanism unknown — suspects: blend order or clip-sort subtlety in the harness setup. Repro: preset_runtime/tests/layer_skin.rs mutual-skin test dumps.

title: P0 spike fixture cannot show emissive map
description: tests/fixtures/scene_fx/p0_emissive_*.json: phong emission rgb defaults 0 and the map MULTIPLIES it, so the fixture can never show an emissive map; two_material_pbr.glb also lacks UVs (map silently dropped). Fix: set emission rgb 1.0 in the fixture and/or switch to a UV-carrying mesh (cubicspline_interp.glb as P4a tests use).

title: Straggler GLB misses can flake warmup tests via record_cold_touch
description: Found by the decode_cache detective 2026-08-22: gltf_mesh_source detached parse threads complete out-of-band; on a cold default cache they record_cold_touch (manifold-foundation) mid-unrelated-test — same race class as the thread_local counter fix (749db8d4c) but the cold_touch counter system, could flake warmup tests. Speculative until seen; fix shape mirrors 749db8d4c (thread-local or initiated-by attribution).

title: wgsl_compute test-module unused Marker import trips clippy --tests
description: manifold-renderer lib TEST build emits unused-import warning: wgsl_compute.rs:3256 `use crate::node_graph::freeze::markers::Marker;` unused inside the test module; introduced by compile-contract P3 commit 34ed0bbc5 (@static_param deletion removed the last use); invisible to plain `cargo clippy -p manifold-renderer -- -D warnings` but fails any clippy --tests -D warnings run; fix = delete the import line
close_reason: Fixed: only one Marker import remains in wgsl_compute.rs (line 50, used in main module); the unused test-module import the clippy error cited is gone

title: Blob tracking overlay renders below native res
description: Peter 2026-08-21: the blob tracking debug overlay (value_overlay node in BlobTracking.json) looks not-crisp, below native res. Root cause unknown; suspects: overlay renders at analysis downsample resolution instead of output res, or label text rasterized small and upscaled. Fix shape: render the overlay at output resolution; check render_value_overlay target dims vs the downsampled analysis frame.

title: VD: warmup load progress bar — L1 reached / L4 target
description: Warmup load progress bar verified only at snapshot level (ContentState.warmup drives it; gates L1). Peter: open a project with a 3D scene in the app and watch the load bar — the one surface no test has seen by eye.

title: VD: warmup load progress bar — L1 reached / L4 target
description: Warmup load progress bar verified only at snapshot level (ContentState.warmup drives it; gates L1). Peter: open a project with a 3D scene in the app and watch the load bar — the one surface no test has seen by eye.
close_reason: Closed

title: rt-capture is not pixel-deterministic — A/B pixel diffs need a control run
description: Found during the rt-quality landing (2026-08-18): two identical rt-capture runs of RtNoiseTesting on the SAME main binary (--frames 360 --frame-clock) differ by up to maxdelta 255 on accumulation channels and maxdelta ~200/meandelta 0.28 on early composite frames (frame 30, mid-convergence). The overnight rt-quality bead expected branch-vs-main maxdelta <= 1 — unreachable with this harness. Consequence: any PNG-level A/B verdict must run a same-binary control pair first and compare distributions, or trust the rt-capture channel stats (which DID match to print precision) instead of pixels. Fix shape: either seed the RT RNG per frame under --frame-clock to make captures deterministic, or document the control-run requirement in rt_capture.rs + RT_QUALITY_SETTINGS_DESIGN-style landing checklists. k3 (lead)

title: gltf_mesh_source: model swap to oversized mesh truncates silently (WARN) to preset capacity
description: Symptom: swapping RtApricotOn to lowe.glb (1.91M verts) renders garbage/nothing; log warns "mesh has 1910439 vertices, capacity 46356 — truncating". Root: preset declares a fixed vertex capacity sized for the original model; project_tool scene set-model swaps the path without resizing buffers. Fix shape: either re-fit mesh buffers to the imported model on load, or refuse the swap loudly in set-model when the model exceeds capacity.

title: Generator fusion still compiles pipelines on the content thread (BUG-j8gy twin)
description: BUG-j8gy moved fused-kernel compile off the content thread for EFFECT cards (async fused_effect_view_for + worker pipeline prewarm, landed e942a559). The generator twin is untouched: fused_generator_def_for (generators/registry.rs:253) is compile-on-miss synchronous at clip build, and the fused generator kernels pipeline then compiles lazily in wgsl_compute::evaluate — the same multi-second content-thread stall class when a generator graph is edited or a clip first starts. Fix shape: route generator fusion through the fusion worker like effects (codegen + prewarm), but generator runtimes have no per-frame rebuild/swap-in handshake — either build unfused and swap on a generation bump (needs a generator-side rebuild trigger) or accept a one-time unfused first run and fuse on next rebuild. Not urgent: clip-start stalls are rarer than graph-edit stalls.

title: DN-M: emissive noise-gate fixture (EmissiveStrengthTest.glb)
description: RAYTRACING_DESIGN.md section 17.7. Add Khronos EmissiveStrengthTest.glb (tests/fixtures/gltf/khronos) to scripts/rt_noise_gate.py fixtures so still-scene emissive shimmer is measurable.
close_reason: Closed

title: audio capture ring has no NaN filter — analysis state can be poisoned persistently
description: From the BUG-84fv NaN audit (pro-raytrace-lifecycle-audit + lead, 2026-08-02): audio features are provably finite from valid audio (silence → 0.0, all divisions guarded), so a NaN can only enter via the capture layer — a CoreAudio/ProcessTap glitch (device-state transition, format change) delivering NaN samples into the ring buffer, which has no isfinite filter (cpal_input.rs:118-122, and check the ProcessTap path too). NaN FFT input → NaN magnitudes → analysis state (kick tracks, flux history) can be poisoned PERSISTENTLY upstream of the audio_mod sanitize landed in c1a0e377. GPU hang risk is already closed by the two landed guards (condition() sanitize + RT kernel rt_finite); this bead is the analysis-state integrity item. FIX SHAPE: isfinite sweep on the analysis worker input hop (off-RT, cheap), count-and-log glitches, and a state-reset if a NaN lands in persistent feature state.

title: AO_MASK_SPECIALIZATIONS exact-string replace breaks on any fs_pbr return edit
description: Symptom: any edit to the literal `return vec4<f32>(rgb, albedo.a);` in render_scene.wgsl fs_pbr (e.g. debug probes) makes naga reject fs_pbr with the opaque "Entry point fs_pbr at Fragment is invalid". Root cause: render_scene.rs:2463-2472 AO_MASK_SPECIALIZATIONS does exact string search-and-replace on that return expression; a changed return silently skips the replacement, leaving a type-mismatched FsOut variant. Cost a lead + two lanes several probe iterations 2026-08-02 (TL-A debug). Fix shape: replace exact-match with a marker comment or regex anchored replacement + a compile-time assert the replacement fired (fail loud at build, not at naga). Found by pro-uniform-offset-audit (lane).

title: seat-identity: kimi/opencode strong-slot collision on deepseek-v4-pro
description: kimi and opencode both carry strong_model=deepseek-v4-pro in providers.toml since the opus slot moved off glm-5.2 (2026-08-02). seat-identity.py step 2 (and statusline.sh) resolve panes without ANTHROPIC_MODEL by matching ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL against each providers strong slot, an invariant now violated — such a pane would resolve ambiguously (the 2026-07-24 authority-inversion class). Dormant today: native-lanes-only means no cc-fleet run panes launch, and the lead pane sets ANTHROPIC_MODEL=k3. Fix shape: resolve collisions by preferring the provider whose default_model matches the pane SONNET slot, or drop step 2 entirely once cc-fleet run panes are fully retired.

title: orphaned hook test suites: test_ask_question_guard.py + test_workflow_gate.py import tombstoned daemon modules
description: Both fail at import (ModuleNotFoundError: common / valve) — the daemon was tombstoned (commit 43865587) and .claude/daemon/ is no longer tracked, orphaning both suites. Fix shape: either delete the two orphaned suites or repoint them at the kept daemon corpus; a hook-suite runner that counts import failures as red would have caught this.

title: probe-loop-guard false-positives + silent denied edits
description: probe-loop-guard counted a planned 7-hunk decided change as a probe loop and denied real work twice; one denied edit (clearcoat signature) was misread as landed, producing a confusing "requires 3 args" failure a cycle later. Fix shape: (a) declare-implementation escape that resets the counter, (b) make the deny result unmistakable in the tool output. k3 (lead)

title: Emission ON darkens near-emitter ground probes ~3% (deterministic) — variance/history clamp suspect
description: Emission ON makes near-emitter ground probes ~3% DARKER (deterministic, glow==black==0.5857 < off==0.6032 at the same probe; seen in the BUG-1gqt cure-test fixture pre- and post-fix). Emission only adds energy, so a clamp is the suspect — variance/history neighborhood clamp responding to added variance near the emitter's penumbra. Repro: gpu_proofs/rt_p3_emissive_texture.rs diagnostics print signed deltas; rt_p3_emissive_gi.rs proof 2 measures the same scene factor-only.

title: Placeholder-spec eprintln spam on project-local preset load — ordering bug or log-once
description: Load of /Users/peterkiemann/Downloads/brokenHelmetRotationsRT.manifold (project-local DamagedHelmet preset) prints 150+ eprintln lines: "keeping param <name> on PresetTypeId(DamagedHelmet) load with a placeholder spec (preset template unresolved — project-local preset not registered yet?)" — one per param. Either the project-local preset should resolve before param reconciliation (real ordering bug — placeholder specs mean param ranges/defaults are guessed), or the keep-with-placeholder path is legitimate and should log ONCE per preset, not per param. Seen 2026-08-01 on release main; same log as the BUG-665r (GPU error/recovery wedge) repro. k3 (lead)
close_reason: Landed f47ce6dd: deserialize-time placeholder warnings silenced (the stash pass knows a reconcile is coming); reconcile pass keeps the BUG-079 warning. Verified on the repro project: no spam, unresolved==0. k3 (lead)

description: scripts/rt_noise_gate.py --record writes ceilings from whatever binary profile happened to be built, and scripts/rt_noise_baseline.json records the commit but NOT the profile. title: Clean the 10 SHADOW_BASELINE presets that bake a card-owned node param
description: Ten bundled presets bake a value onto a node param that an outer card owns, so the baked value is discarded at build and the card default is what renders. All ten are dead authoring residue, not intent — six bake amount=0.0 under a card shipping 1.0 (ColorGrade, Dither, EdgeDetect, Glitch, Strobe, VoronoiPrism), and SoftFocus bakes radius 4 under a card default of 6. Baselined in SHADOW_BASELINE (crates/manifold-renderer/tests/card_binding_shadow_corpus.rs) so a NEW preset with the same mistake fails, while the existing ten do not block. SEQUENCING NOTE (lead, 2026-07-30): the shadow finding is currently loud to tests only — it lands in PresetRuntime::errors() and nothing app-side reads that, deliberately. A runtime log or warning would be the natural completion of "make it loud", but it would fire on all ten of these on load, so the order is: clean the residue here first, THEN wire a runtime warning. Doing it the other way ships noise on shipped content. Fix shape: strip the shadowed node-param values from the ten preset JSONs (the card default is the shipped look, verified), shrink SHADOW_BASELINE to empty, then open the runtime-visibility follow-up.

title: Concurrent rt-capture runs clobbered each other via a shared /tmp dir (was: intermittent all-zero RT channels)
description: ORIGINAL REPORT: 10 identical rt-capture runs on origin/main gave 3 alive, 7 with every RT channel at exactly 0 and mask pinned at 255 while the composite still rendered. REFRAMED 2026-07-30 after re-measuring: not reproducible under single-tenant release conditions. Release build, nothing else touching the GPU: 5/5 alive, run-to-run spread 1-4% (composite mean 0.080-0.083, refl_raw 0.626-0.632). Debug build at 120 frames: 2/2 alive. Two confounds identified, both present when the original numbers were taken. (1) SHARED OUTPUT PATH, the main one: rt_capture.rs wrote to a fixed /tmp/rt_capture and cleared it on entry, so two concurrent captures destroyed each other frames. Three sessions were capturing in parallel that evening, and the lead independently ran rm -rf on that directory between its own captures, which is very likely what emptied the agent runs. FIXED: the directory is now overridable via MANIFOLD_RT_CAPTURE_DIR and rt_noise_gate.py always uses a private per-process one. (2) BUILD PROFILE: the dead runs were a debug binary, which is several times slower and can land on the other side of the D17 async accel-build race; the gate now builds release. WHAT IS STILL UNEXPLAINED and why this stays open at P3: the original alive runs disagreed with each other by ~12 levels of mask mean (252.147 twice, 239.820 once), which clean release runs do not show, and no one has demonstrated a genuinely dead RT frame under isolated release conditions. If deadness ever appears again in a single-tenant release run, that is a real accel-readiness race and belongs back at P1 with the BUG-jddy residency class as the second suspect.

comments.author: Peter Kiemann
comments.text: Rate, 10 runs on origin/main b10d9d94 (same binary, same project, same command, back to back): 3 ALIVE / 7 DEAD, so roughly 30% alive. Dead is always the identical signature — refl_raw exactly 0.000 mean level, mask exactly 255.000. Alive runs are not identical either: refl_raw 38.193 / mask 252.147 in two of them, refl_raw 39.620 / mask 239.820 in the third, so visibility/AO coverage itself varies run to run by ~12 levels of mask mean. That second-order variance matters for any gate ceiling drawn from a single run.

comments.author: Peter Kiemann
comments.text: RETRACTED as a measurement artifact — my error, recording it so nobody chases it. The all-zero RT channels were almost certainly shared-directory contention, not an RT defect. rt_capture dumped to a hardcoded /tmp/rt_capture and cleared it on entry, while three RT sessions (this gate, petal shadows, NormalTangentMirror) captured in parallel all night: each run wiped the others frames mid-flight and could read a foreign projects channels, which is exactly how refl_raw reads 0.000 with mask pinned at 255 on a project that traces fine. Two pieces of evidence. (1) With no other capture running, 3 of 3 consecutive 300-frame runs came back clean, zero discarded, and the spread across them is tiny — composite mean 0.079 to 0.079, refl_raw 0.704 to 0.711, irr_full 1.305 to 1.311. Nothing like a 30% alive rate. (2) The two "alive but different" runs I cited (mask 252.147 vs 239.820) are better explained by reading two different projects frames than by RT variance. Not airtight: I did not manage to reproduce the dead state by deliberately running two captures concurrently (the binary got rebuilt without perf-soak under me and that experiment never ran), so this is inference from the mechanism plus the clean isolated runs, not a positive repro. Fix is in: rt_capture now honours MANIFOLD_RT_CAPTURE_DIR and the gate sets a per-pid private dir. What would reopen this: an all-zero channel run with a private capture dir and no other capture process on the machine.

title: project_tool cannot strip a .manifold down to a committable fixture
description: The RT noise gate (scripts/rt_noise_gate.py) needs a project fixture, but no .manifold can be committed: RtNoiseTesting.manifold is 53MB — 28MB of undo history and 11MB of embeddedPresets around ~0.5MB of actual timeline. Stripping history + embeddedPresets and repointing the mesh at a tracked GLB would land it under 1MB, well inside what tests/fixtures already carries. Blocked because project_tool has only info/json/tempo/clip verbs, none of which can drop those blocks, and CLAUDE.md forbids hand-editing the ZIP. Fix shape: a project_tool "strip" verb (--drop-history --drop-embedded-presets --repoint-asset OLD=NEW) built on the existing surgical raw-JSON edit + validate_and_save path, then commit the stripped fixture with git add -f (DamagedHelmet.glb is already tracked past the same gitignore rule). Until then the gate resolves tests/fixtures/rt/RtNoiseTesting.manifold, gitignored and propagated into slots by agent-worktree.py.

title: RT gpu-proof first-runtime warmup transient: refl_raw reads all-black for the first PresetRuntime in the process
description: In the gpu-proofs binary the FIRST PresetRuntime built in a process reads its refl_raw RT capture back entirely black (non-black fraction 0.0000) no matter how many frames it settles for (400 tried); the second identically-configured runtime reads 0.0897. Proven by swapping variant order - the black one follows position, not configuration. Same family as the transient rt_r3_heldout_gltf already absorbs with a bounded baseline retry. Consequence: any RT gpu-proof that compares two freshly-built runtimes measures ORDER unless it discards a warm-up variant first (rt_normal_tangent_mirror.rs now does, with a comment). Root cause unknown - suspects: async accel build completion handler vs the reflection history ping-pong, or first-use pipeline/heap warm-up on the shared device. Fix shape: find the real settle signal and expose it so tests can poll it instead of guessing frame counts, which removes the warm-up hack from every RT gate.

Landing gate 2026-10-01 on land/renderer-stale-tests: rt_r3_heldout_gltf::heldout_helmet_mr_map_changes_traced_reflection panicked "rt=0 raster baseline for DamagedHelmet.glb rendered ~black (frac=0.0000) after retries" (rt_r3_heldout_gltf.rs:268). title: probe-loop-guard evidence file is write-only: accept a commit message or a repo-tracked path
description: probe-loop-guard.py only unblocks when an evidence table of >=200 chars is written to /tmp/manifold_seam_review.md. That file is write-only — nothing reads it, it is clobbered on every reset, and it dies with the machine, so the evidence it forces you to produce is thrown away. Keep the >=200 char bar either way.

title: Global SSAO multiplies unlit materials — imported unlit surfaces can never render flat while the ao group is on
description: node.ssao_gtao is wired into every glTF import post-chain unconditionally (gltf_import/scene.rs) and multiplies the whole scene color regardless of material kind, so node.unlit_material surfaces keep an AO gradient. Fix shape: SSAO needs a per-material or per-surface mask (respect unlit / emission-only surfaces), a renderer-level question. Live escape hatch exists: ssao_intensity card param (BUG-y5w7 stopgap). Found by BUG-w5wv lane 2026-07-28.
close_reason: Fixed by RAYTRACING_DESIGN section 12 (Screen-space AO handoff) — this beads own recorded fix shape (a per-material/per-surface AO mask). ao_mask is 0 for unlit-kind (baked_look) materials, and the import AO group multiplies through it. Proof: baked-look surface passes the group at 0.000000 delta while its lit neighbour on the same contact corner darkens 6.92% (gpu proof baked_look_passes_through_lit_neighbour_darkens) — both legs, so it cannot pass by AO simply being dead.

description:
### BUG-020 — Card collapse animates effect cards but not generator cards — LOW (deferred)
**Status:** DEFERRED

**Symptom** — found 2026-07-04 (UI motion P2 batch 1). Effect cards collapse/expand with the
`collapse_anim` reflow; generator cards do not — their rows parent at root (`None`) in
`ParamCardPanel::build_generator`, so there is no `ClipRegion` seam to clip the collapsing

title: BUG-116 — fire-meter-display-ballistics-reads-as-low-fps
description:
### BUG-116 (fire-meter-display-ballistics-reads-as-low-fps) — fire meters read as updating at low FPS despite a 60fps capture/snapshot/UI pipeline — LOW (deferred by design)
**Status:** DEFERRED — Peter 2026-07-11 ("leave this slow update for now"), found while adding the producer/consumer fire-meter round-trip test (`bug/fire-meter-unification`).

**Symptom** — a card's/clip-trigger's Amount meter visibly reads as updating slowly, more like a
peak-hold VU meter than a live level bar, even though nothing downstream of the content-thread
capture is actually throttled.

**Root cause — intentional, not a bug in the pipeline itself.** The pipeline is 60fps end-to-end:
the audio-analysis worker's hop is ~5.3ms, `evaluate_all_audio_mods`/`LiveTriggerState::evaluate`
push a fresh `FireMeterCapture` every engine tick, the `ContentState` snapshot carries it to the UI
thread every tick, and `ParamCardPanel`/`AudioTriggerSection::update_fire_meters` write it into the
meter every UI tick. What the performer actually sees is display-side peak-hold smoothing added
deliberately by BUG-109 P5: `MeterIds::update` (`crates/manifold-ui/src/panels/drawer.rs` ~245-306)
snaps a rising level up instantly, then HOLDS it for `PEAK_HOLD_SECONDS = 0.25` before decaying at
`PEAK_DECAY_PER_SEC = 5.0` (full-scale 1.0→0.0 in ~200ms) — added specifically so a millisecond-
scale transient's shaped envelope (which decays faster than the UI's own tick cadence can sample)
stays visible at all between snapshots, per that fix's own comment. The tradeoff is exactly the
symptom: a steady/fast-changing signal reads as chunkier and slower than the raw 60fps capture
underneath it.

**Fix shape** — not a wiring bug, so no root-cause removal; two ballistics directions if revisited:
1. Tune the constants down (shorter `PEAK_HOLD_SECONDS`, faster `PEAK_DECAY_PER_SEC`) — trades away
   some of BUG-109 P5's "the transient stays visible" guarantee for a snappier feel.
2. The pro-audio split: an instant, unsmoothed live bar (tracks `level` every tick, no hold) plus a
   separate thin peak-hold TICK mark riding above it (only the tick keeps BUG-109 P5's hold/decay).
   Keeps both properties instead of trading one for the other, at the cost of a second draw
   primitive per meter.

**Instrument impact:** cosmetic/feel-only — the underlying signal a mod fires on is unaffected (the
edge-detector reads the raw conditioned value, never the display-smoothed one); this is purely
"does the meter look as fast as the audio is," which is why Peter deferred it rather than folding
it into the round-trip test session.

title: BUG-325 — box-animated-test-renders-all-zero-frames
description:
### BUG-325 (box-animated-test-renders-all-zero-frames) — the four-phase box animation test renders all-zero frames on main, and rewrites its goldens while failing
**Status:** OPEN (found 2026-07-24, RT-R1 full gpu-proofs run; reproduced on the main checkout, so pre-existing — not caused by the wave).
**Severity:** LOW (test-only), PLUS a fixture-poisoning hazard: the failing run MODIFIES the four `tests/fixtures/gltf/goldens/box_animated_p0*.png` files (all-zero frames written over real goldens) — anyone committing after a test run without checking `git status` lands corrupted goldens. Restored with `git checkout --` when found.
**Symptom:** `box_animated_four_phase_pngs_are_visibly_distinct` panics: "progress 0.25 and progress 0.5 rendered byte-identical frames — the clip isn't animating"; both frames are all-zero (nothing rendered at all, not a static render).
**Root cause:** UNKNOWN. Suspects: (a) the animation decode produces no keyframes in this environment (codec/FFmpeg path), leaving an empty scene; (b) same all-zero headless-render class as BUG-323 (core data never reaching the node) — UNVERIFIED whether box_animated's geometry arrives inline or via a binding.
**Fix shape:** first establish whether the all-zero output is empty-scene (nothing drawn) vs black-scene (drawn, no light) via a depth/normal readback in the test's own harness, then follow the split (empty → geometry/decode path; black → lighting/env path). Fix the golden-rewrite side effect regardless: the test should write goldens only on an explicit flag.
close_reason: Root cause: point_camera_down_to_see_inner_box matched binding ids cam_tilt/cam_dist, renamed to {node_doc_id}_{param} (5_tilt/5_distance) by 4dc3dd1b — silent no-op, default camera, 3 of 4 phases identical. NOT all-zero frames: the bead symptom was misread off the truncated assert dump; frames are 50.7% non-black (check BUG-323 for the same misread). Golden poisoning fixed via assert_phase_sequence_distinct: frames to MESH_SNAP_OUT_DIR, goldens only under MANIFOLD_REBASELINE_GOLDENS=1 after asserts pass. All 24 frames byte-match committed goldens. Landed 1a8ffaa1.

title: BUG-209 — animated-ancestor-above-joint-tree-sampled-statically
description:
### BUG-209 (animated-ancestor-above-joint-tree-sampled-statically) — root motion authored on a node above a skin's joint tree is frozen — promoted from BUG-205's "known remaining approximation" note, 2026-07-17
**Status:** OPEN — LOW (no real asset observed exhibiting it: Mixamo roots motion inside the rig at Hips; the Sketchfab Bip01 case bakes animated values ≈ its static TRS).

**Symptom (predicted):** a rig whose ancestor prefix genuinely animates (translation/rotation/scale keyframes with values that CHANGE) plays its pose correctly but stays pinned in place — the prefix motion is dropped.

**Root cause:** `gltf_skeleton_pose` roots joint worlds at `joint_root_world` — the STATIC ancestor-chain product (`static_world_matrix`), by design (GLTF_ANIMATION_DESIGN.md A2). Post-BUG-205 the rigid `gltf_animation_source` no longer re-applies the chain (that was a double-transform, not a fix for this), so the animated prefix has no carrier at all.

**Fix shape:** extend the pose primitive with prefix tracks — sample the ancestor chain's animated TRS per frame (one extra Table keyed like the joint tracks, joint index -1 or a dedicated `prefix_tracks` param) and compose it in place of the static `joint_root_world`. Gate with a shelf fixture whose prefix translates across the frame (make_hostile_rig.py variant: keyframe the `UnitConversion` empty).
close_reason: Fixed on lane/gltf-skinned-fixes: root joints compose through resolve_world_whole_scene (animated ancestor channels + bind fallback) instead of the static joint_root_world; unanimated chains byte-equivalent, tested both directions
